## Using `curl`

```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments" \
     -H "x-apikey: ABC321" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Confirmed #malware"}}'
```

* Replace `ABC321` with your actual API key if it’s different.
* Make sure you’re using the correct endpoint (`/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip}/comments`) – the URL above is for the v3 API.

---

## Using Python (requests)

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "ABC321",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Confirmed #malware"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```
